title: Solar wind
description: Internal mission control for NOAA SWPC real-time solar wind (ADR 0007). Speed, density, and Bz use rows where active is true. Pipeline health reads ingest_log, not the measurement tables. Narrow window: each panel is one full-width row, so a phone-width browser stacks them. Grafana still draws its own menu and time picker, and these charts do not switch to a larger mobile axis. Below 640 px the page is tall, and that menu can crowd a 320 px window. This is the internal view; the public page is a later React app.

panels.title: Proton speed
panels.description: Solar-wind proton speed for the spacecraft SWPC marks active. Units are km/s. A typical slow wind is a few hundred km/s; a fast stream is roughly 500 km/s or more. The bucket is one minute because the feed is one-minute samples. A null minute is a gap, not a zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(proton_speed) AS "km/s"
FROM solar_wind
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Proton density
panels.description: Proton density for the active spacecraft, in protons per cubic centimeter. Dense slow wind is often several protons/cm3; fast wind is thinner. Same one-minute bucket and active-row filter as speed. If two spacecraft are marked active in the same minute, the point is their average.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(proton_density) AS "protons/cm3"
FROM solar_wind
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bz (GSM)
panels.description: North-south magnetic field in GSM coordinates, nanotesla, active spacecraft only. Negative Bz is southward: that is the direction that lets solar-wind energy into Earth's magnetosphere. The line is red below zero and green at or above zero. Zero is the center of the axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(bz_gsm) AS "nT"
FROM rtsw_mag_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Minutes since last good ingest
panels.description: Reads ingest_log only. A good run has error null: the file was loaded. Rows that failed validation increment rows_rejected and still leave error null, so they count as good. The number is the age of the older feed (wind or mag). If any feed that has a log row has never succeeded, the panel says 'no good ingest' instead of hiding that feed behind the other one. The poll is every SWPC_POLL_MINUTES (5). Yellow means 15 minutes, red means 30.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN count(*) < (SELECT count(DISTINCT source) FROM ingest_log) THEN NULL
    ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - min(last_good))) / 60.0
  END AS "minutes"
FROM (
  SELECT max(finished_at) FILTER (WHERE error IS NULL) AS last_good
  FROM ingest_log
  GROUP BY source
) per_feed
WHERE last_good IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Narrow window
panels.description: Limitation for a phone-width browser, recorded here because this dashboard is internal Grafana (ADR 0012). The About page is docs/about/solar-wind.md.

options.content: Each chart is one full-width row, so a narrow window stacks speed, density, Bz, and the health stat instead of squeezing them side by side. Grafana keeps its own menu and time picker. These charts do not grow a simplified mobile axis. Below 640 px the page is tall, and the menu can crowd a 320 px window. This view was laid out on the 24-column grid; it is not a mobile-first page. About this page: [docs/about/solar-wind.md](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/about/solar-wind.md).
